lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a grid-like distribution posterior to the gill slits, with primary clusters concentrated in the mid-lateral section above the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: High-intensity vertical bands intersect with horizontal ridges to form a rectangular framework, with high-luminance blobs serving as nodes at or between these intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature on the upper third of the flank, displaying a sharp luminance transition from a light upper edge to a shadowed lower edge, extending from the branchial region toward the posterior.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance circular spots scattered across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin, predominantly located within the lower half of the fin silhouette.
